name: cantilever_eb_ts
source: Euler–Bernoulli + Timoshenko shear: δ=FL³/3EI+FL/κGA=0.5952+0.0194=0.6147mm (I=3456mm⁴, κ=5/6, G=1286.8MPa); σx(z)=M(x)·(z-6)/I, M(0)=3000N·mm
notes: Fully-integrated Hex8 is over-stiff in bending → underpredicts δ ~16% at pitch 2 (6 cells through thickness) — documented accuracy, beam_convergence case tracks it to the reference. Stress probes sit at mid-span, far from clamp/tip end effects, and use cell-centre depth (z=11 → c=5mm, not the surface fibre). sx-probes verify the linear bending profile through the section; vm near the neutral axis is dominated by transverse shear τ (≈1.2MPa at z=5), not σx.
